$comment: Worked example of a three-row peer_attestations chain. prev_self_ref is per-peer (NOT a global hash chain across all of the actor's peers — see ADR-0007 audit amendment 3). The per-peer scoping is what makes selective disclosure safe: disclosing peer X's chain reveals nothing about peer Y's writes. content_hash is the digest of the underlying state-write's canonical bytes (cloister: bead-canonical.ts); it's NOT recomputed by the attestation step.

fixed_inputs.$note: The cert + sig fields in each row store raw bytes; this test vector elides them as 'cert_b64' / 'sig_b64' placeholders for layout-only verification. A full byte-exact vector would require running an Ed25519 signing oracle; that's the ref-impl's job.

chain.name: genesis_row
chain.description: First state-boundary write for this (actor, peer) pair. prev_self_ref is NULL; prev_peer_ref MAY be NULL (peer hasn't claimed a counter chain head yet) or the peer's first-call counter hash.

row.sig_b64: (Ed25519 sig over canonical_bytes || prev_self_ref where prev_self_ref is the empty string for genesis, by implementation choice)

chain.name: second_row
chain.description: Second state-write. prev_self_ref MUST equal genesis_row.content_hash exactly. Implementations MUST reject a write whose prev_self_ref doesn't match the chain head; cloister returns `prev_self_ref_mismatch` and writes nothing.

chain.name: third_row
chain.description: Third state-write. prev_self_ref now points at second_row.content_hash. prev_peer_ref MAY advance independently to whatever counter-chain head the peer claims in this request envelope.

rejection_cases.name: wrong_prev_self_ref
rejection_cases.description: Caller submits seq=2 with prev_self_ref=0xdead... when the chain head is 0x1111... . Implementations MUST refuse the INSERT and surface the mismatch (cloister returns {ok:false, error:'prev_self_ref_mismatch'}).

rejection_cases.name: globally_chained_prev_self_ref
rejection_cases.description: An implementation that chained prev_self_ref across all peers (a bug ADR-0007 audit finding 3 explicitly warned against) would leak peer-existence at disclosure time. Verifiers SHOULD validate that the chain step references the same peer's prior row only.
